correctness.rationale: Direct two-zone killed diffusion boundary equation and interface matching yield the exact one-turn Laplace transform. Independent renewal intervals, fair signs, exponential-tilt renewal theorem and full-domain Gartner–Ellis derive the signed-turn SCGF and LDP. Large-s hyperbolic asymptotics prove the fixed-positive-reset factor four and logarithmic correction. An independently discretized BVP and root solver passed 105 finite assertions; computation supplements rather than proves asymptotics.

value.rationale: The geodesic shortest-return rule naturally measures topological transport on a ring. A universal factor-four reduction in rare-current cost for every arbitrarily small positive reset rate is a structural and experimentally interpretable noncommutation phenomenon, not a rephrased mean first-passage calculation. The sharp logarithmic term distinguishes the rare trajectories and defines a plausible observable beyond existing variance-level results.
